page.notes: Left margin notes transcribed at their places: "o Ad populum Antioch. Hom. 38." beside the Chrysostomus line, and "* Lib.3.de beneficiis, cap.6." beside "argutè". The reference mark before Chrysostomus is a small square-like sign in the scan; I have read it as "o" to match the note. "furus" at the start of the page is doubtful (first letter could be an f-like or i-like form). Faint show-through from the reverse side and the neighbouring page edge are ignored. "Dei" at the lower right is treated as the catchword.
